nhl.coach_expectation_delta.measurement: P_exp = 0.6*points pct (season-1) + 0.4*points pct (season-2), plus nhl.prior_to_current_blend roster-change term (minutes-weighted 3-season RAPM of arrivals minus departures, per 82 games, converted at 0.015 pts pct per goal/60-game); computed in-house so no archived preseason projection is required. Delta_t = points pct to date (games before as-of date t) minus P_exp; SE = sqrt(p(1-p)/n_games_played). Final delta per simulation = (banked points + simulated rest-of-season points from nhl.team_season_points_distribution)/(2*82) minus P_exp. Jack Adams choice model (coach branch of nhl.award_vote_share_model): candidate set = every head coach who ran >=41 regular-season games of one team (about 32); U_c = b1*Delta_final + b2*(Delta_final - Delta_prev_season) + b3*first_year_with_team; P(win) = exp(U_c)/sum_j exp(U_j), averaged over simulations (a coach fired before the threshold drops out of that draw). Fit as a conditional logit on winners 2005-06 onward, augmented with a rank-ordered (exploded) logit on the NHLBA top-3 finish order from published 5-3-1 point totals; ridge penalty chosen by leave-one-season-out log loss; at most 3 covariates. Use only games before t.
free_sources: MoneyPuck preseason projections (optional cross-check only; multi-season archive unverified)

nhl.award_vote_share_model.measurement: For each award collect the last 20 seasons' finalists and vote shares; regress log vote share on points per game, goals, team points percentage, games played, position and for goalies wins, save percentage and shutouts; fit multinomial logit with season fixed effects and shrinkage; apply to the projected end-of-season stat line distribution from simulations; output win probability by candidate with draw uncertainty; update with finalists and ballot dates. Source caveat (SOURCE_UNVERIFIED for the Ted Lindsay Award): full vote shares are not known to be published for player-voted awards (only finalists and the winner), so where shares are missing fit a conditional-logit on winner-among-finalists instead of a share regression; with only a few dozen finalists per award use at most 4 covariates and strong shrinkage. Coach branch (Jack Adams, NHL Broadcasters' Association electorate, 5-3-1 ballot, individual ballots unpublished): a separate coach-level conditional logit over all ~32 head coaches on nhl.coach_expectation_delta (final delta, change versus prior-season delta, first-year flag) as specified in that input; no player production covariates are used for it.

nhl.standings_stakes.measurement: Clinch/elimination status per team and date from 10,000 standings simulations (status fixed when P(playoffs) is 0 or 1 to the simulation's resolution). Tanking adjustment for points rates after the trade deadline: for team-games 2005-06 onward after the deadline, residual = actual standings points minus expected points from the team rating frozen at the deadline (home, rest, opponent adjusted); regress residual on eliminated flag, bottom-5 rank flag, net deadline man-games value traded away (TOI-weighted RAPM per 82 games of departed minus arrived players) and marginal lottery value of one extra loss = change in P(top-2 pick) per rank place from nhl.draft_lottery_odds_by_standing under the format in force that season (3 draws 2016-2020; 2 draws with 10-spot move-up cap from 2021, worst team 18.5% first-draw odds). Coefficients shrunk toward 0 with a normal prior sd 0.05 points/game. Clinched-team rest effect: star participation rate in final 5 games versus season rate.
nhl.standings_stakes.rationale: Late-season games have heterogeneous effort and rest. Clinched teams rest stars (last 2-5 games); eliminated bottom teams sell veterans at the deadline, play call-ups and backup goalies, which lowers their points rate below the pre-deadline rating; the lottery incentive is weak since the worst team only has 18.5% first-draw odds and the 10-spot cap guarantees it a top-3 pick, so the effect must be estimated and shrunk, not assumed.

nhl.goalie_start_forecast.measurement: Regular season: per-team classification of starter rotation rules (b2b second game backup, 3-in-4 rule), logit model of P(starter) using rest, schedule and recency, plus reporter-source reliability weights. Playoff branch (no back-to-backs; rotation rules do not apply): hazard of starter change before game g+1 = logistic(a + b1*(game g save pct - incumbent season save pct) + b2*1[pulled in game g] + b3*goals allowed in game g + b4*(backup minus incumbent season GSAx/60) + b5*elimination-game flag + b6*incumbent injury flag), fitted on 2005-06 onward playoff goalie game logs (NHL API game type 3; Hockey-Reference playoff logs) with games started as the outcome; coefficients ridge-shrunk; a change resets the hazard for the new starter. Output: P(each goalie starts) per remaining game, mixed into team strength as a goalie-quality mixture.
